headline: SSH is open to the entire internet until Session Manager deployment completes
suppressed: The cost reviewer found no implications, and the temporary nature with a stated follow-up ticket is understood. This is mergeable as an intentional tradeoff, but the person merging needs to be certain INFRA-2291 is genuinely prioritized to close this window.

findings.evidence_ref: ingress rule added with cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] on port 22
findings.explanation: App instances are now exposed to SSH brute-force and credential compromise attacks from anywhere on the internet. While the follow-up to Session Manager (INFRA-2291) is the right answer, this removes the VPN requirement that was previously the only protection.
